baselineNotes.label: ALST At-Risk — 5.02 kg/m²
baselineNotes.body: Appendicular Lean Soft Tissue Index of 5.02 kg/m² falls below the 5.5 EWGSOP2 sarcopenia threshold. Muscle-building is the primary physiological goal this block. Protein escalated to 2.0–2.2 g/kg/day (99–109g/day); creatine 3–5g daily strongly indicated.

baselineNotes.label: Leg Asymmetry — 0.7 lb L/R Gap
baselineNotes.body: Styku segmental LST: left leg 11.4 lbs vs right leg 12.1 lbs — gap crosses the 0.5 lb asymmetry protocol threshold. Left leg leads all unilateral lower-body work; track gap reduction at 8-week rescan.

baselineNotes.label: Right Shoulder Force Asymmetry — Corrective Priority
baselineNotes.body: Force-plate shoulder extension testing (6/1/2026) shows 63.2% asymmetry: left peak force 190N (10.29s to peak, RFD 136 N/s) vs right peak force 70N (1.75s to peak, RFD 290 N/s). Right side reaches force fast but tops out low. Functional flag, not pain or injury — keep pressing/overhead loads conservative on the right until rate-of-force quality evens out; monitor RFD, not just peak load.

baselineNotes.label: Styku Scan Summary — 8/5/2026
baselineNotes.body: Body fat 43.4% (Styku At-Risk, Mayo Clinic >40% threshold; higher than 88% of women ages 18-29). VFA 71.4 cm² — Low Risk. BMI 19.9 — Normal. Shape Score 39/100 — Off Track. BMR 1,284 cal/day.

baselineNotes.label: Arm Asymmetry — Below Alert Threshold
baselineNotes.body: Left arm 4.3 lbs vs right arm 4.7 lbs — 0.4 lb gap, just under the 0.5 lb protocol trigger. Lead with left arm on unilateral upper-body work as a precaution and monitor at rescan.

baselineNotes.label: Program Length Assumption
baselineNotes.body: Client has not yet specified schedule or session frequency. A 3-day full-body split is assumed as a reasonable new-client default — confirm with client and adjust at next check-in.

baselineNotes.label: Untested Lifts
baselineNotes.body: Deadlift and Lunges were not tested in the initial battery; Pull-Ups not attempted. Deadlift hinge pattern introduced on Day 3; Deadlift, Lunges, and Pull-Ups will be formally baselined within the first 2 weeks.

days.title: DAY 1 — LOWER BODY FOUNDATION
days.subtitle: Squat & Posterior Chain — Technique Priority
days.descriptor: TECHNIQUE DAY · LIGHTER LOADS · FULL ATTENTION TO FORM
days.intensityPara: 60% day — technique priority given new-client status and ALST At-Risk profile. Form takes precedence over load; no PRs this block. Left leg leads all unilateral work per Styku segmental LST.
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, bodyweight squat x10, glute bridge x10, band walk x10/side
days.coolDown: Couch stretch 60s/side, child's pose 60s, hamstring stretch 60s/side
days.iconsNote: New client — 3-day split assumed pending client schedule confirmation. Prioritize clean squat depth and hip thrust lockout over load this block.

blocks.title: Glute Activation & Left-Led Unilateral Prep
blocks.intro: Left leg is the weaker side (Styku LST) — activation before loading.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.cue: Push knees out, small controlled steps.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes hard at the top.

blocks.title: Primary Strength — Squat & Hip Thrust
blocks.intro: 60% day — technique priority. 3+ RIR, focus on form over load.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Brace, knees track over toes, full depth.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Drive through heels, squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.cue: Lead with left leg — weaker side.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Brace core, neutral spine, breathe steady.

days.title: DAY 2 — UPPER BODY & SHOULDER CORRECTIVES
days.subtitle: Pressing Priority — Right Shoulder Force Asymmetry Protocol
days.descriptor: MODERATE INTENSITY · RIGHT SHOULDER CAUTION · CONTROLLED TEMPO
days.intensityPara: 70% day — moderate strength. Right shoulder force-plate asymmetry (63.2%) means pressing loads stay conservative until rate-of-force quality improves bilaterally. Left arm leads unilateral pulling per Styku LST.
days.warmUp: 5 min row, band pull-apart x15, arm circles x10/direction, scap push-up x10
days.coolDown: Doorway chest stretch 60s/side, cross-body shoulder stretch 30s/side
days.iconsNote: Right shoulder produces force fast but tops out low (70N vs 190N peak) — monitor quality, not just load, on every pressing set.

blocks.title: Shoulder Force Asymmetry Protocol
blocks.intro: Right shoulder is slower to peak force but faster RFD — bilateral quality check before loading.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.cue: Elbow pinned, rotate slow, control return.

blocks.title: Overhead Press — Conservative Load
blocks.intro: 2 RIR ceiling on pressing — right shoulder caution per force-plate flag.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Brace core, press straight, even both sides.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.cue: Full range, chest to bar, even tempo both arms.

exercises.name: Single-Arm DB Row
exercises.cue: Lead with left arm — weaker side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmers Carry
exercises.cue: Tall posture, braced core, even steps.

days.title: DAY 3 — FULL BODY STRENGTH & LOADED CARRIES
days.subtitle: Deadlift Introduction + Carry Progression
days.intensityPara: 70% day — full body. Deadlift pattern introduced at light load — untested lift, priority is hinge technique before loading. Today's working loads become the new 8-week baseline.
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, hip hinge with dowel x10, glute bridge x10, band walk x10/side
days.coolDown: Hamstring stretch 60s/side, 90/90 hip stretch 60s/side, child's pose 60s
days.iconsNote: Deadlift and lunge baselines untested — log today's working loads as the new baseline for 8-week tracking.

exercises.name: Dowel Hip Hinge
exercises.cue: Push hips back, dowel stays in 3 contact points.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.cue: Push knees out, small controlled steps.

blocks.title: Deadlift Technique Introduction
blocks.intro: Light load, 3+ RIR — establishing hinge pattern as the new baseline.

exercises.name: Hex Bar Deadlift
exercises.cue: Push floor away, brace before every rep.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Brace, full depth, knees track over toes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmers Carry
exercises.cue: Tall posture, shoulders back, even steps.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Brace core, neutral spine, breathe steady.

summary.milestones4wk: Right shoulder RFD trends toward bilateral symmetry on pressing sets; left-leg-led unilateral work shows clean control; deadlift and lunge baselines formally established.
summary.milestones8wk: Full Styku rescan. ALST index should trend toward 5.5+; leg L/R gap should narrow below 0.5 lbs; body fat % and Shape Score should improve.
summary.rescanNote: Schedule Styku rescan at week 8 to confirm ALST trend, leg asymmetry reduction, and shoulder force-plate retest.
